body: GARRIM GYR, master enchanter and binder of spells, leader of the Luchuirp in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: a gnome-like Luchuirp dwarf; male; elderly; small, stooped and wiry, about half a man's height. Ruddy, wrinkled skin, a big round nose, a long braided snow-white beard, bushy white eyebrows, sharp blue eyes.
costume: ash-grey enchanter's robes embroidered in charcoal and silver, with a leather apron of small tools.
signature: His small round BRASS SPECTACLES, a set of extra hinged lenses folded up at their sides, are always on his nose.

vibes.name: Crystal Thrall
vibes.line: his left hand holding the crystal on a folded cloth, his right hand clamped around his left wrist, holding it back; eyes wide on the crystal, full of its red-violet light, mouth pulled down tight; his dark study at midnight, black mist curling, the crystal lighting him from below.
vibes.wears: a long deep-violet scrying robe with silver warding runes stitched down its front and cuffs, sleeves pushed back, a black velvet skullcap.

vibes.name: Golem Father
vibes.line: his left hand pressed flat on the vast stone forearm of a waking golem, his right hand turning a brass key in a socket at its wrist; eyes on the viewer, beaming like a grandfather showing off a grandchild; a mountain foundry hall at night, forge glow and drifting sparks.
vibes.wears: a heavy scorched leather forge apron hung with brass tools over a rust-red work tunic, sleeves rolled past the elbows, a soot-dark leather cap.

vibes.name: Binder's Guilt
vibes.line: his right hand slowly smoothing the scorched, folded apron of his dead apprentice on the workbench, his left hand gripping its edge; head bowed, shoulders sunk, red-rimmed eyes lowered to the apron; the apprentice's empty corner of the workshop at night, one guttering candle, cold blue moonlight at the window.
vibes.wears: a plain black wool mourning coat buttoned to the throat, a black cloth band around one sleeve, no apron, no tools, no ornament.

vibes.name: Brass Spectacles
vibes.line: three extra lenses flipped down over his spectacles, his right hand guiding an engraving needle along a rune on a coin-sized brass cog, his left hand pinching the cog in tweezers; eyes huge behind the lenses, fixed on it, tongue poking out; bright morning light through a round workshop window.
vibes.wears: a moss-green craftsman's waistcoat over a white linen shirt, sleeves gartered up, a leather apron bristling with tiny tools and gauges.
